text:
deadlock: 3 agents wait on each other in a cycle and none can move:
  api (devin-0df2d079545f49d19b529bb0ef620cc1) -> waits on auth (devin-c8e7bd8ba96e47e79a7a6e5a65a65e6d) for 1m: its HTTP interface (the /login route shape)
  auth (devin-c8e7bd8ba96e47e79a7a6e5a65a65e6d) -> waits on db (devin-84c922c2db4248ed8383d4d84af09d92) for 1m: the users migration
  db (devin-84c922c2db4248ed8383d4d84af09d92) -> waits on api (devin-0df2d079545f49d19b529bb0ef620cc1) for 1m: approval of the users schema
Every one of them is alive and healthy; the cycle is why nothing happens.
Break it: pick one edge and resolve it from outside (give the approval yourself, drop the dependency, reorder the work, or stop one agent). To stop one: `agsv send <id> "stop: ..."` then check it in Devin.
